node.label: Arbitration & investment disputes
node.summary: Enforcement of arbitral awards and India's aim to be an arbitration hub.

facts.text: SC: governments resisting enforcement undermine India's aim to become an **international arbitration hub**.
facts.plain: SC: governments resisting enforcement undermine India's aim to become an international arbitration hub.

facts.text: The dispute came from a **1994 production-sharing contract**; the arbitration was seated in **Kuala Lumpur** under **UNCITRAL** rules.
facts.plain: The dispute came from a 1994 production-sharing contract; the arbitration was seated in Kuala Lumpur under UNCITRAL rules.

facts.text: SC (Justices **J.B. Pardiwala** and **Manmohan**) upheld enforcement of about **$99 million** in foreign arbitral awards to **Vedanta** over the **Ravva oilfield** (Krishna-Godavari basin).
facts.plain: SC (Justices J.B. Pardiwala and Manmohan) upheld enforcement of about $99 million in foreign arbitral awards to Vedanta over the Ravva oilfield (Krishna-Godavari basin).

facts.text: SC (CJI Surya Kant, Justices Joymalya Bagchi and **Vipul Pancholi**) appointed former SC judge **Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai** as sole mediator in the **KG basin gas migration** dispute between **Reliance Industries** (and partners) and the Centre.
facts.plain: SC (CJI Surya Kant, Justices Joymalya Bagchi and Vipul Pancholi) appointed former SC judge Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai as sole mediator in the KG basin gas migration dispute between Reliance Industries (and partners) and the Centre.
